findings.description: check_validation_report catches bare Exception around gate_logic.pre_merge_gate, so a programming error inside gate_logic would also be reported as 'failed to read validation-report.md'. It still fails closed (status=fail) and names the exception class, so the verdict is safe; narrowing to OSError/UnicodeDecodeError/ValueError would only sharpen the message.
findings.resolution: Catching bare Exception was chosen intentionally to satisfy the spec requirement that an uncaught exception must not crash expedite and must fail closed. Narrowing exception types is optional and could be considered in a future refinement.
